facts.business: Mufin Green Finance Limited is an RBI-licensed, technology-led NBFC offering accessible financing to individuals and businesses across India, including Mediclaim premium financing, salary-linked loans to government employees, electric vehicle and solar ecosystem financing, and loans to corporates and MSMEs.
